# [LIMINA-COL] raw vertex-record bytes (first 16 per binding view), seated desktop 2026-06-09.
# Layout (stride 32, software-transform): pos float3 @0-11, color u8x4 @12-15, tex0 2xf32 @16-23,
# bytes 24-31 = layer-1 texcoord PADDING (cogl pads n_layers to >=2; 1-layer entries never write it).
# Draw 2's v3 padding = 28f94977 -> float 0x7749f928 = 4.1e33 (stale garbage); v4/v5/v6 = denormals.
# NOTE: the tex1/padding theory was subsequently DISPROVEN as the bug mechanism —
# [LIMINA-PIPE] (pipe-descriptors.txt) shows the broken draws' pipelines declare NO attribute over
# bytes 24+, and LIMINA_TEX1_ZERO (zero the padding in all binding views) does not heal the dock.
# Kept because it documents (a) the verified-correct pos/color/tex0 INCLUDING z and color alpha,
# (b) that zink invalidate-fresh buffers carry real garbage in unwritten regions.
